notes.title: Patch Update and Fix Details
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

Thank you for your interest in Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond!

After a long time coming, it feels great to have this game out of the development stage and release it into the wild. Whether you're continuing your journey from Celestian Tales: Old North or a player new to the world of Celestian Tales, we hope you've been enjoying the game and cast of characters.

As you can imagine, despite the time and effort we have spent on making this the best experience possible, Realms Beyond is not without its shortcomings. Among others are bugs that have been identified in the early days of release, some of which have been discovered by players. 

We have periodically updated the game to fix flagged bugs, with all critical ones fixed in less than a day after they were discovered. Other minor issues followed periodically, and the most recent update had been delivered just today.

Here's a list of fixes we have delivered up until today:

May 26, 5.00 AM
- Fixed issue where the fireplace in Aramis Mansion cannot be used for crafting
- Fixed issue in Summerlight Gardens where the character turns back and re-enters the previous map
- Added clear save file generation after finishing the game
- Fixed the final boss treating defeat as victory continues the story

May 18, 1.09 AM
- Fixed camera in AY Prologue
- Fixed Law Abiding / Law Bending Priest achievements not triggering right afterwards
- Fixed Westwood world map icon targeting wrong map
- Fixed follow-up event not immediately triggering after boss fight in Ertheros

May 15, 09.30 AM
- Fixed event trigger after crafting (Blacksmith quest at Orsea) 

May 14, 11.00 PM
- Fixed hammer crafting on Orsea village during Blacksmith quest 
- Fixed party composition during Aramis quest 
- Fixed unreachable item on Montcalm 

May 13, 03.03 AM
- Add choices from Old North at prepare scene 

May 11, 09.44 PM
- Changes on several events and NPCs

May 10, 07.50 AM
- Fixed repeating event in Aramis Mansion after returning from Ertheros 

May 9, 03.53 PM
- Fixed Rua dialogue using wrong face
- Removed chapter 1 change screen

May 9, 08.26 AM
- Fixed NPC position in Godland which made it possible to get stuck
- Fixed Tribulation Hall lever name
- Fixed Artur's NPC dialogue in Kiahonoa acting like player has already finished quest
- Disabled access to Mudtown after events at Godland

May 9, 03.43 AM
- Fixed Hall Guardian in Kiahonoa preventing player from continuing
- Fixed characters duplicating in Westwood event
- Equipped most character skills from the beginning of the game
- Disabled access to Levantine after the escape event

May 9, 12.35 AM
- fixed party members not swapping when finishing Reynard/Lucienne/Ylianne path in Westwood
- added Kickstarter backer NPCs
- fixed some camera panning and dialogues
- fixed all three prologue Achievements unlocking despite only one path chosen

May 8, 12.41 AM
- Fix issue where player can be teleported to wrong Aramis Mansion version
- Fix some quest states where player splits path not converging properly
- Fix blocker in Levantine triggering test events
- Fix Gizmotin being seen in his first event
- Added several dialogue cinematics
- Fix issue where event leading to Ertheros voyage can be re-triggered

May 7, 10.05 PM
- Additional dialogues in the event leading to final fight
- Fixed Split Armor effect to actually reflect damage
- Edited cameraworks in Aria/Ylianne prologue
- Fixed NPC Barrel Lady collision in Fort Griveaux
- Fixed cleric in Fort Griveaux not loading her crystal wares
- Fixed NPC Camron walking when we talk to him
- Added 99Tales LLC logo as Localization in credits
- Fixed some players being transported to wrong version of renovated Aramis Mansion after Eastwood, which prevented further event-triggers

Our team continues to monitor the Steam Community forum daily to check if there are any new reports. We thank you deeply for reporting these issues to us and hope we can make your time in Celestian Tales even better.

Enjoy your time in Realms Beyond!

notes.title: Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond Available Now
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond is now available for purchase.

[b]The purchase price is $14.99 with a 10% launch discount.
[/b]
Inspired by classic JRPG’s, the story is fused with a beautiful hand-drawn world, pixel animations and an immersive soundtrack. 

[b]Come experience the House of Levant 9 years later.[/b]

For newcomers to the world of Celestian Tales, the other games in this world (Celsetian Tales: Old North, Howl of the Ravager and the additionally DLC) will be will be participating in the release celebrations by  running a massive discount starting shortly.

We thank you all, especially our Kickstarter backers in making this day 5/7/2020 so special for us.

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
We are so pleased to finally be able to make this update. The journey has been long, but Celestian Tales Realms Beyond is complete and ready for release. We appreciate the continued interest by you in this game, whether you were a  Kickstarter Backer or just a fan of Old North, and we hope the result makes the wait worth it. 

Right now we are targeting May 7th as the release date. There a few approvals that we need to finalize and some coordinating we need to complete between the various distribution channels. 
This may yet change again as certain things are out of our control, but we are hopeful this will remain the date. 

These are trying times for all of us, and we hope you're all safe and healthy wherever you are. Hopefully this update can help shine a little more light to your day.

notes.title: Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond Releases Demo & Launches Kickstarter
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30495593/aaeb99d00100315831ae612294abfcb3a9581bce.png[/img]

Please checkout our recently launched Kickstarter to learn more about the game. https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ekuatorgames/celestian-tales-realms-beyond?ref=d93s6s 

We are excited to announce the release of a demo for Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond.  Pick up where you left off in Old North or experience the House of Levant for the first time.

If you have played Celestian Tales: Old North, the game will read your end save and shape the game's world based on the choices you've made. If you haven't and you don't have the time to play Old North, Realms Beyond is designed to accommodate new players into the setting.

We have been in development for almost 2 years, and expect the full game to be a available this winter. Please checkout our recently launched Kickstarter to learn more about the game. https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ekuatorgames/celestian-tales-realms-beyond?ref=d93s6s
